text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf and I are training on the
track
when an unexpected visitor
appears.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I need to have a word with you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Brian? What brings you here?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The director barged her way into the
student
council office and started
ranting about some
kind of emergency.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It seemed like a pain,
so I figured I'd let
you sort
it out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see. I had better take care of this
immediately.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer, but I need to speak
with Brian. I
shouldn't be long.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This matter has turned out to be far
more
complex than I anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Addressing it will require some decisive
moves on
the part of the student council
president—which
is to say, me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid I need some time to bring it to
a proper
resolution.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Actually, it might take the rest of the
day to deal
with.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Although, if I were to prioritize only
the parts
that require my input, I could
be done in short
order.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You're correct, of course. Thank you for

understanding.
choice_data_list: You should focus for a full day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I will spend the rest of the day giving
this matter
my full attention.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'll see you tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
True to her word, Symboli Rudolf
resolves
Director Akikawa's emergency
within the day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Of course. I won't be long.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm back. Sorry to have kept you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I told you I could do my part in short
order, didn't
I? Brian and the others will
start work on the rest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Not to worry. I will rejoin them once we
are
finished here.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now, where were we?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
True to her word, Symboli Rudolf
manages to
navigate her obligations with
the finesse I've
come to expect.
